entry.name: Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC)
entry.note: A vendor-neutral consulting credential from a private certification body
entry.audience: Consultants and leaders advising organisations on AI strategy

covers: AI and ML algorithms, tools, techniques, architecture, and frameworks
Deployment and management of AI models in production
Neural network application design and troubleshooting
Translation, speech recognition, and image classification
AI application development, deployment, testing, and maintenance
Fraud prevention with Cloud AI solutions
reading.format: Self-paced training module with study books, eLearning materials, workshops, and hands-on videos.
reading.summary: The Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC) is a certification for AI professionals. It covers approaches, models, and workflows for leading complex AI projects, including building, implementing, and scaling AI tools and infrastructure. Holders are expected to develop and deploy AI data systems, design and troubleshoot neural network applications, and manage AI models in production. The program also addresses translation, speech recognition, image classification, fraud prevention, sentiment analysis, and advanced robotics.
reading.audience: The page describes it as a fit for mid-level AI professionals seeking AI or ML consultant roles, and states that programming skills are not mandatory to apply.
reading.prerequisites: Programming skills are not mandatory to apply.
